path: see density-sources.txt.provenance.json; each row of propellant-densities.js names its source tag and an exact quote from density-sources.txt
note: Hand-transcribed from snapshots/density-sources.txt (the verbatim excerpts). mixture.test.mjs checks that every quote occurs in that file and that each value is the quoted number converted to kg/m^3. Primary choice per row: NIST at the temperature thermo.inp assigns the cryogens; NASA SP-125 Table 1-4 (68 F) for the storables and RP-1; HSDB via PubChem for ethanol; NIST for water. Independent review (2026-10-31): added the measured 95 % hydrogen peroxide blend (SP-125 Table 1-4, 1.414 g/cc at 77 F) and corrected the LOX cross-check note (the scan has the decimal point; the PDF text layer drops it).
